question: Water reservoirs, dams and embankments were found at which Harappan site?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dholavira**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Water reservoirs, dams, and embankments** were found at the Harappan site of Dholavira in Gujarat, India
 
• **Dholavira is known for its advanced water management system**, which includes a network of stone-cut reservoirs and canals.
 
• The **reservoirs were used to collect rainwater, which was vital in the rainfall-deficient region.**
 
• **Other archaeological evidence of water supply systems from the Harappan civilization includes: Wells with brick lining and Similar evidence at Mohanjodaro and Harappa**
